verdict.summary: Round 1's major security-contract defect is resolved. The diff removes the false "non-reversible" characterization everywhere it touched, explicitly documents that FNV-1a is an unkeyed non-cryptographic checksum permitting offline guessing, identifies UPDATE payload sensitivity, and adds a non-vacuous witness test that reproduces the exposed fingerprint from candidate text. The UPDATE registry wiring shares the HTTP-visible registry with both initial and restored writer instances, carries the cancellation flag into the real update budget, and holds the RAII guard across application. The end-to-end tests exercise the real HTTP list/cancel path, verify whole-update rollback, registry cleanup, and continued writer availability. No new correctness, soundness, security, or hostile-instruction issue is evident in the diff.
